name: Canada
summary: Northern American nation with expansive boreal ecosystems and Arctic watersheds. Experiences subpolar warming at more than double the global rate and unprecedented wildfire seasons despite abundant clean hydroelectric generation.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.36x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); baseline pristine air punctuated by record wildfire smoke excursions in 2023.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; warmest year on record in Canada driven by intense subpolar amplification.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Subpolar warming trend rate of +0.48 °C per decade over 1994-2023 trailing three decades.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.4% share of global fossil emissions; driven by oil sands extraction, refining, and space heating.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Among the highest per capita emissions in the G20 due to cold climate, large geographic distances, and resource extraction.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~3,470,000 km² of circumpolar boreal forest; represents 9% of total global forest cover.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Heavy hydroelectric foundation (57.8%) supplemented by expanding onshore wind (6.1%) and biomass.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 4.3 people/km²; concentrated within 100 km of the southern border.
